boss_sanho.constructed: Four-view 256x128x128 visual hull, marching cubes, Taubin smoothing and meshoptimizer body; closed-volume paddles, branches, curved sea-fan webs and barnacles merged into one skinned mesh.
boss_sanho.rig: Carapace, plastron and coral are rigid on spine_3. Neck uses spine_0..2. Front flippers use fin chains; rear paddles and tail use spine_4..5.
boss_sanho.remainingVisualLimit: Sea-fan web and branching coral are simplified within 5000 triangles; fine porous lattice and subtle neck-to-shell texture transitions remain less detailed than the illustration.

boss_geomeun.constructed: Four-view visual-hull fusiform body, closed-volume pectorals, dorsal/anal fins, yellow finlets, caudal keels and tapered crescent lobes. Scars are texture only; no fishing line.
boss_geomeun.rig: Spine weights follow body X. Caudal lobes are rigid on spine_5. Dorsal/anal fins use spine_2..3; pectorals use fin chains.
boss_geomeun.remainingVisualLimit: The front-to-side projection transition around the gill and nose is still visible at close range; fine fin rays and gill folds are mainly texture detail.

comparison.baselineTurtle: Actual makeDetailedTurtle code snapshot, green_sea_turtle without boss look; original geometry and texture mapping, neutral review lighting.
comparison.camera: Orthographic, normalized X length 2; same PBR lights and exposure for baseline and boss.
comparison.approvalNote: Structural validation is not visual approval. No numerical self-rating or automatic pass for likeness.
